text:
Steven Stamkos is 36 and has 12 goals in 22 games, eighth among 547 skaters in wins added by his goals. He came into the season with 624 career goals, two Rocket Richard trophies and two Stanley Cups from his Tampa years, and Nashville is getting the shooter it paid for. He has a four-game point streak going.

There is a catch, and our numbers flag it plainly. He has 12 goals on 8.5 expected (the quality of his chances), shooting 23% against 20% last season. The chances are real, but that finishing rate rarely lasts, and our talent range puts his true shooting closer to 17%. Thirteen of his 23 points have come on the power play, where his one-timer still does damage.

At 5v5 it is harder. Nashville is 4.5 points worse in expected goal share with him on the ice than off. Evolving-Hockey had last season the other way: expected wins well ahead of actual. So the goals may have arrived a year late. Sean McIndoe of The Athletic recently asked whether veteran stars like Stamkos have played their last playoff game. Nashville's November gives him an argument.
headline: Stamkos, still scoring at 36
